title: Talking with evangelicals and Pentecostals
tagline: "Born again", "Bible only", altar calls and speaking in tongues: listen first, then answer.
whyItMatters: Evangelical and Pentecostal friends often share our love of Christ and ask sincere questions about salvation and the Spirit. Knowing their words and the Catholic Charismatic Renewal helps you meet them where they are.

mindset.tip: Ask for their story of faith and listen. Give your reasons with gentleness and respect. (1 Peter 3:15-16)
Affirm what is good: love of Christ, of Scripture and of mission. Catholics can say "yes" to being born again and then explain how.
Do not mock their worship style. The Church recognises spiritual gifts and asks that they be tested. (CCC 799-801; 1 Corinthians 12-14)
Answer "Are you saved?" with a story of grace, not a lecture.
Invite, do not corner: shared mission is a better start than a debate. (CCC 819)
